{
  "states": [
    "CLOSED",
    "LISTEN",
    "SYN-SENT",
    "SYN-RECEIVED",
    "ESTABLISHED",
    "FIN-WAIT-1",
    "FIN-WAIT-2",
    "CLOSE-WAIT",
    "CLOSING",
    "LAST-ACK",
    "TIME-WAIT"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "LISTEN",
      "event": "CLOSE Call",
      "action": "Return 'error: closing' to outstanding RECEIVEs; Delete TCB",
      "to": "CLOSED"
    },
    {
      "from": "SYN-SENT",
      "event": "CLOSE Call",
      "action": "Delete TCB; Return 'error: closing' to queued SENDs or RECEIVEs",
      "to": "CLOSED"
    },
    {
      "from": "SYN-RECEIVED",
      "event": "CLOSE Call (no SENDs issued and no pending data)",
      "action": "Form FIN segment and send it",
      "to": "FIN-WAIT-1"
    },
    {
      "from": "ESTABLISHED",
      "event": "CLOSE Call",
      "action": "Queue until preceding SENDs segmentized; Form FIN segment and send it",
      "to": "FIN-WAIT-1"
    },
    {
      "from": "CLOSE-WAIT",
      "event": "CLOSE Call",
      "action": "Queue until preceding SENDs segmentized; Send FIN segment",
      "to": "LAST-ACK"
    }
  ]
}
